subject: Private hosting: decision criteria, ops handoff & next steps
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Perez <alyssa@medilink.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-17T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Private hosting: decision criteria, ops handoff & next steps

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the concrete next steps so we stay aligned.

Pain points you flagged
- Data residency: PHI must remain in US regions and be retained per your policy.
- Strict network segmentation: no public ingress to model-serving hosts; egress only to approved endpoints.
- Auditability: long-term audit logs and key-access records required for SOC2 and client audits.

Goals we agreed on
1) Proof-of-concept (3 nodes) in your VPC with customer-managed subnets and private NAT.
2) End-to-end demo with ops team present to validate firewall/egress rules and logging.
3) A security readiness checklist and acceptance criteria that allows your compliance team to sign off.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Alyssa: share the cloud account owner contact and a short network inventory (subnet layout, NAT gateway, firewall vendor). You mentioned you'd send that by EOD Friday.
- Ops deep-dive: propose Tue 2026-08-24 10:00 PT for an operations-focused meeting (we'll invite our infra engineer and Marissa for compliance questions).
- We'll provide a VPC pre-qualification checklist and a sample firewall-rule template (attached: redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx, vpc-firewall-template.txt).

Attachment(s): redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), vpc-firewall-template.txt (text)

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock the ops slot. If any of the recap items above are off, please flag.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
From: Alyssa Perez <alyssa@medilink.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Samuel Green <sam.green@cardiowell.org>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private hosting: decision criteria, ops handoff & next steps

Connor,

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications:
- We can share network inventory; I will send the initial spreadsheet tonight. Our VPC is in us-west-2 and uses Palo Alto firewalls.
- Egress: we need to whitelist only AWS S3 endpoints (logs) and our monitoring collector at 52.23.17.65. No outbound internet allowed from the serving subnet.
- Retention: audit logs retained for 7 years; we will need proof that logs are immutable for that window.

Tue 8/24 10:00 PT works for us. I'll invite our infra lead, Miguel, and Dr. Green will join for compliance context.

Attaching a one-page network summary (stubbed here as 'medilink-network-summary.pdf').

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Perez
Head of Cloud Ops | MediLink Health
alyssa@medilink.com | +1 206-555-0199

Connor—

Thanks for the tidy recap. Two operational items I want to propose before the ops call:
1) Risk acceptance: draft a short paragraph that defines which infra risks MediLink can accept vs. which require formal mitigations (e.g., ephemeral admin access, patching SLAs). We'll use that to get buy-in from our Solutions Security team.
2) Pre-call checklist: ensure Miguel has the VPC CIDR, SGs, and the jumpbox access method documented. If they prefer an air-gapped model we may need to push the schedule by 2 weeks.

Marissa—are you able to join the call and lead the compliance acceptance conversation? If yes, please bring the 'private-deploy-scope.pdf' we keep in Drive.

-B
